newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Cab driver saves Colombian baby from street death.
newsitem.headline: Cab driver saves Colombian baby from street death.

text.p: A half-naked newborn baby was saved from certain death by a Bogota cab driver who plucked her from a rain-soaked, darkened street of the capital early on Friday, authorities said.
Police said the baby girl was no more than about five hours old when she was discovered by cab driver Hector Fabio Bejarano abandoned under cover of pre-dawn darkness on a street corner.

Overnight temperatures dropped as low as 35 degrees Fahrenheit (two Centigrade) and police quoted doctors as saying she would have frozen to death if she had been left exposed for more than another 20 minutes.

The 25-year-old Bejarano, who rushed the baby to a hospital where she was recovering in the warmth of an incubator, told reporters he hoped to become the baby's godfather but was probably too poor to adopt her.
